Definition: Allon, an Israelite, also a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: The name belongs to a man and a place. Allon the son of Jedaiah is counted among the princes of Simeon, and Allon is a town on the border of Naphtali, where the coast runs from Heleph to Zaanannim; two uses, and the name is all the Bible says of either.
TheologicalSignificance: A name shared by a man and a town carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the care of the record, that the men of the tribes and the towns of the borders are named alike.
